# AbstractContinuum

> Continuous iterative development and deployment console for
> AbstractFramework: a thin React client over a Run Gateway's
> development-lane APIs — live execution pipeline (executor-agnostic;
> Codex CLI today), backlog browsing/editing, report/email triage, and
> managed prod/UAT process control. High-trust surface: a signed-in user
> can redeploy services (see SECURITY.md).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, pages, quick start
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): first run + first execution
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): system shape, exec pipeline state machine, module layout, executor seam
- [API](docs/api.md): consumed gateway API families + served session endpoints
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): server env vars, proxy knobs, gateway feature gates, browser settings
- [Security](docs/security.md): trust model, session/CSRF mechanics, execution safety (UAT vs inplace)
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): observer vs continuum, executor agnosticism, write-only env vars
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): sign-in, executions, inbox, processes, dev setup
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Source map

- src/lib/gateway_client.ts: typed gateway client (dev-lane families only)
- src/ui/executions_page.tsx: live "executing now" landing page
- src/ui/backlog/: backlog + exec pipeline modules (model.ts is pure + unit-pinned)
- src/ui/report_inbox.tsx, src/ui/email_inbox.tsx, src/ui/processes_page.tsx: the other pages
- bin/cli.js: static serving + app-origin gateway session proxy
- docs/backlog/overview.md: package-local work backlog

## Provenance

- history.md: born 2026-07-12 from the abstractobserver split (observer
  observes/discusses; continuum develops/deploys)
